Name: Champagne Wishes
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
[color=#ea9999][u][i][b]IMPORTANT SDV 1.6 Announcement: [/b][/i][/u][/color][i][b]  [/b][/i]Looking for a 1.6 update to this mod?  Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30226]Champagne Wishes Continued[/url]! Shads has graciously agreed to take over management of Champagne Wishes, including new recipes I was planning prior to the announcement of Stardew Valley 1.6!



Are you in the mood to be [i]fancy[/i]?  This mod adds Champagne Grapes (Year 3+ Spring trellis crop) and the ability to make Champagne and Champagne Vinegar.  Also included are a selection of recipes and cocktails to make use of all this bubbly stuff- with more fancy recipes to come!

[i][b]The PPJA suite of mods (Fruits and Veggies, More Trees, Artisan Valley, Starbrew Valley) and its associated frameworks and Better Artisan Good Icons are all REQUIRED for this mod to work in full!

Additionally:[/b] [/i]The recipes "Blini with Caviar" and "Champagne Sorbetto" can only be purchased through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5245]PPJA - Khadija's Recipe Shop[/url].  If you do not have this mod (and its dependencies) installed, it will not cause any errors with Champagne Wishes, but these two recipes will be unavailable.
The "Ice" object from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5245]Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats[/url] is a required ingredient for the "Champagne Sorbetto" recipe.  If you do not have this mod installed, this recipe will not be available.
[i][b]
[/b][/i]Once you have all the required mods installed, simply extract into your mods folder and enjoy some Champagne Wishes and Caviar Dreams!
